dedupe_keys.name: imagery dataset for rooftop detection and classification lozenets sofia

description: This dataset contains 3,617 GeoTIFF images of individual roofs, clipped with a 2-metre buffer around each roof outline and masked, sorted into four classes: flat, gable, complex and 'bug' (images that are not usable buildings, such as construction sites or fragments). It was published on Zenodo on 12 February 2023 by Emil Hristov, Dessislava Petrova-Antonova, Alexander Petrov, Milena Borukova and Evgeny Shirinyan of the GATE Institute at Sofia University. The source orthophoto was flown in 2020 with an UltraCam Eagle Mark 3 camera at 2,850 to 3,200 metres, covering 1,961 square kilometres including 1,342 square kilometres of Sofia Metropolitan Municipality, at 10 centimetres per pixel in urban areas. Coverage: the Lozenets district study area of 9.2 square kilometres. Access: one RAR archive of about 423 MB on Zenodo. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: one district and four coarse roof classes. Simulation uses: roof type recognition for rooftop solar potential, 3D city models and building energy archetypes; the authors also suggest roof segmentation and roof element detection. Related records: the DLR rooftop PV suitability maps and RoofSceneX.
